text: the amount is refunded to source. Decision Points If the request qualifies under standard criteria, proceed with automatic processing. If suspected fraud indicators are present at any step, halt standard processing and route per the Fraud & Security Response SOP. Exception Handling Transactions flagged as suspected fraud are routed to SOP_C18_FRAUD_RESPONSE instead of standard reconciliation. Retail POS cash transactions follow the Retail Cash Reconciliation SOP (out of scope here). Validation Confirm the account/system reflects the expected end state before the case is closed, and obtain customer confirmation where applicable. Escalation Unresolved cases are automatically flagged for supervisor review after the stated SLA window, ensuring no request is left without a defined next action. SLA / Timing First-line resolution target is same working day; escalations to specialist teams carry a 2-3 working day SLA. Audit Requirements Every action taken under this SOP must be logged against the account with agent ID, timestamp, and outcome for audit and quality-review purposes. title: Handling Failed / Stuck Recharge Transactions
